speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) what percentage of families currently receiving the ComLink+ enhancement package have had at least one session with their appointed family coaches and what is the expected frequency in the number of future check-ins with family coaches; and (b) among households eligible for ComLink+, what is the current average monthly pre-school fees per child above three years old.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: For those supported by a case worker from a Family Service Centre (FSC), there is contact from the outset as in-person assessments are done before a case is opened.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The frequency of engagements by family coaches or FSC case workers is based on the family's needs.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development's (MSF's) approach is not to focus on the output, that is, to measure the number of visits, but on the outcomes, that is, to measure the actions the family has taken.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: If a family is doing well, the frequency of visits may be reduced.
